description: Destination allowlist for anthys runtime egress. The application containers, not the offline analysis sandbox, are the only workloads allowed outbound connections. Enforcement is at the host firewall / enterprise egress gateway; this file is the reviewed source of truth and contains no credentials.

dns.note: Block direct UDP/TCP 53 to any other destination; do not allow DNS-over-HTTPS to unlisted hosts.

allowedDestinations.purpose: robot messages, cards, attachment download URL exchange, OAuth user token exchange
legacy robot reply addresses already accepted by the sender
reviewed read-only company MCP endpoint; exact origin comes from COMPANY_MCP_CONFIG_FILE
allowedDestinations.note: Add the reviewed endpoint host here before enabling. Generic chat credentials never authorize this destination.
Separate endpoint and scope from company-mcp; disabled while unset.
Empty disables remote attachment fetching. Wildcards are not allowed.

allowedDestinations.purpose: search provider selected and approved by the enterprise
allowedDestinations.note: No search host is approved or configured. Keep denied until a reviewed provider and data-egress approval exist.

deniedDestinations: 127.0.0.0/8, ::1 (loopback; only the local health check may use it)
rules: Deny by default; allow only exact hostnames and ports listed above.
Re-resolve each outbound request and reject redirects to unlisted hosts.
Do not permit inbound connections to worker/scheduler/maintenance; only api:64700 is published, on loopback behind the TLS reverse proxy.
The analysis sandbox has no network namespace and must never be granted egress.
